quotes.author: Derrick Williams
quotes.text: Had an exceptional fishing outing with Captain Chad and his Deckhand Gabe. Customer service was beyond expectations.

quotes.author: Patrick Orouke
quotes.text: Weather forecast blew up on us the night before, when we showed up to the dock Chad offered to reschedule for the next day but we couldn’t make that work.
A great day with Captain Chad! A limit of speckled trout and some white trout. Great communication on directions to Hopedale Lodge. A perfect day on the water from beginning to end!!
Had an awesome time with Captain Chad! Would highly highly recommend booking with Cajun Outcast. Good times and lots of fish:)!
Great guide willing to put in the time to make sure you’re taken care of. This guy will put you on the fish!

quotes.author: Captain Chad
quotes.text: Replied on June 11, 2026Derrick Williams, Thank you! You folks were awesome. Looking forward to our next trip. Gage and I had a blast fishing with you and Bruce. We are both looking forward to round 2 with you all. Thanks again my friend

We had a great time on a birding trip with Captain Chad and Gage. They were very friendly and shared lots of information and stories about the area. The waterways and marshlands are beautiful! Captain Chad was very communicative and flexible when the weather forecast didn't look great. We thoroughly enjoyed our trip.

I could not ask for a better captain and deckhand. The trip was worth it. We limited out speckled trout and we had quite a few large ones. Over 20 inches. Was the best time I’ve had out on the water in a while. I will definitely be booking another trip.
